outline: Engineering Material introduces the physical, chemical,and basic mechanical properties of materials commonly employed in civil engineering works. Influence of these properties on the performance and use of materials are also included.
schedule:
Tentative schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to civil engineering materials (1)
Week 2: Introduction to civil engineering materials (2)
Week 3: Aggregates
Week 4: Concrete (1)
Week 5: Concrete (2)
Week 6: Masonry (1)
Week 7: Masonry (2)
Week 8: Midterm simulation
Week 9: Midterm
Week 10: Wood (1)
Week 11: Wood (2)
Week 12: Bituminous materials and mixtures
Week 13: Iron and steel (1)
Week 14: Iron and steel (2)
Week 15: Plastics and Soils (1)
Week 16: Plastics and Soils (2)
Week 17: Final examination simulation
Week 18: Final examination

Midterm: 25-30%
Final examination simulation: 0-5%
Final: 35-40%
